entries.gap: IHP SG13G2 draws the slits of a wide metal on datatype 24 of the metal layer. The openems adapter reads datatype 0 only, so a slotted ground plane becomes a solid plane.
entries.symptom: No message. On a three-port junction over a slotted Metal1/Metal2 ground, the reflections differ by 1.1 dB to 1.2 dB from a model with the slits, at every frequency from 1 GHz; with the slits cut, the difference is 0.2 dB at 1 GHz.
entries.workaround: Give the input cut {"Metal1": [24], "Metal2": [24], ...} for each slotted layer. Check the metal area in plan.json against the drawing minus the slits.
entries.evidence: README.md, section EM S-parameters (validation against a stored multi-layer model)

entries.gap: A TopMetal2 line of 800 um x 18 um over a 120 um Metal1 ground (SG13G2_200um.xml stackup, PML_8 sides and top, PEC bottom) does not reach the end criterion -40 dB: the energy is at -15.7 dB after 52000 time steps and -19 dB to -24 dB after 200000. The same line at 300 um and 600 um reaches -40 dB. The cause is not known.
entries.symptom: The port job fails with 'the end criterion -40 dB was not reached'; the energy falls slowly, it does not stop at one level.
entries.workaround: None proven. Candidate: simulate a 600 um section (it converges) and add the remaining length with the input deembed (a negative length_um adds a uniform line), then check against a second section length.
entries.evidence: evals/em-line-s21/README.md (the task line was changed from 800 um to 600 um)
